vocabulary.name: Declared from generators
vocabulary.description: The declared relation generated by asserted pairs.

vocabulary.name: Declared from licence
vocabulary.description: The declared relation generated by the steps of a dynamics that a licence licenses.

vocabulary.name: Declared from classification
vocabulary.description: The declared relation generated by the steps of the preserving operators of a classification.

vocabulary.name: Surface signature
vocabulary.description: The identity-treatment signature of a record: its outcome under each identified use.

vocabulary.name: Record surface
vocabulary.description: The record surface: the mechanism is the record itself, and the one use returns it. It treats two records the same exactly when they are equal. It satisfies surface control, so Lean admits it. It is not an implementation artifact. The requirement that a mechanism be drawn from a disclosed registry is what excludes it, and that requirement is a disclosure claim, not a Lean condition.

vocabulary.name: Joint surface
vocabulary.description: The joint surface of two surfaces: the pair of their mechanisms, with the uses of both. Its control holds because equal pairs have equal components.

vocabulary.name: Faithful check
vocabulary.description: Check faithfulness of `O` to `D` on every pair of an enumerated domain.

vocabulary.name: Find witness
vocabulary.description: Search the enumerated pairs for a divergence witness.

vocabulary.name: Audit
vocabulary.description: The verdict for a declared relation `D` and treatment relation `O` on an enumerated domain, given whether the audit's assumptions are established.
